You are checking scope for PR #70 on the zimmermann-pwa repo (branch `feature/SFCC-91_pdp-ui-colour-swatches-variation-selection`, currently checked out, head SHA f9c6c74), as part of a `zimmerMANNReview` run by Marcel (FED Lead) reviewing a colleague's (Jhoan's) PR — not a build you're running yourself.

Your normal brief is scoped to a single build step's manifest; here there is no single-step manifest — instead judge scope against the **ticket's 5 acceptance criteria** for SFCC-91 (PDP colour swatches):

- AC1: single-colour product shows a "Colour: <name>" text label only, no swatch row
- AC2/3: one swatch per populated/orderable colour value, with the selected one visually indicated
- AC4: clicking a swatch updates the URL (`?color=`) without a full page reload
- AC5: a colour with no resolved swatch image is withheld entirely (not shown, not shown disabled)

Full diff: `git diff origin/develop..HEAD` (but see the staleness caveat below — this PR's branch predates the already-merged SFCC-194 "Was/Now price" story, so a large chunk of that diff is NOT something Jhoan touched, it's just absent from her stale branch; don't count the disappearance of `variantScopedPriceData`/`isPriceStale`/`masterProductRef`/`selectVariantScopedPriceData` as an under-delivery or unauthorized removal — those simply don't exist yet on her branch's base commit `04039a9`, confirmed directly: `git show 04039a9:overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx | grep -c variantScopedPriceData` returns 0). Use `git diff $(git merge-base origin/develop HEAD)..HEAD` instead if you want a cleaner view of just her actual commits' changes, or read her 7 commits' individual diffs via `git log --oneline origin/develop..HEAD` then `git show <sha>` per commit.

**What to check:**

1. **Every file in the diff — is it plausibly connected to SFCC-91, or is it drive-by/unrelated scope creep?** Full file list: `.claude/registry/{components,pages,utils}.md` (auto-generated, not a finding), `e2e/features/pdp/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.feature` (new), `e2e/support/pages/ProductPage.js` (+1 line), `e2e/tests/zimm/pdp/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.spec.js` (new), `overrides/app/components/product-view/colourSwatches/{colourSwatches.css.ts,index.stories.tsx,index.test.tsx,index.tsx}` (new, the core component), `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` (+20/-3, the `suppressColourAttribute` prop), `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` (+69/-1, wiring), `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/partials/staticProductHeader.{test.tsx,tsx}` (new `afterContent` slot), `overrides/app/static/translations/compiled/*.json` + `translations/*.json` (i18n), `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (+2, recipe registration), `overrides/app/utils/filterImageGroups.ts` (new utility), `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs` (+57/-4) + `scripts/generateRegistry.test.mjs` (new). Flag anything that looks like scope creep with its tier and why.

2. **The `variant="square"` change on `product-view/index.tsx`** — was `variant={id === 'color' ? 'circle' : 'square'}` changed to an unconditional `variant="square"`, unscoped to the `suppressColourAttribute` branch. This affects every OTHER caller of `ProductView`'s default swatch loop that does NOT set `suppressColourAttribute` — cart quick-add, wishlist, bonus-product, AND the PDP's own set/bundle child products (which are explicitly out of scope for SFCC-91 per the ticket, which is standalone-PDP only). Confirm this reading is correct by reading the current file yourself, and give your own scope verdict on it: is this OVER (an unauthorized behavioural change reaching outside the ticket's stated boundary — standalone PDP only) or is there something in the diff/PR body that scopes or justifies it that a scan might miss?

3. **Does the PR deliver all 5 ACs, or is anything under-delivered?** Read `colourSwatches/index.tsx` and `product-detail/index.tsx`'s wiring yourself and check off each AC against real code, not the PR body's own checklist claims.

4. **Tier check.** Per `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md` and `protectedFiles.md`: was any Tier 1 file touched? (`theme/foundation/**`, `ssr.js`, `config/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, etc.) Is `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (Tier 2, UI-designer-owned per `protectedFiles.md`) touched only for registration (2 lines: import + key), or does it also introduce new design token values (which would need designer sign-off beyond registration)?

**Report:** your standard IN SCOPE / UNDER / OVER / BLOCKED verdict, but organized per the 5 ACs plus a separate verdict specifically on the `variant="square"` question and the scripts/translations/e2e additions (are they legitimately in-scope support work for this ticket, or unscoped extras). Be specific with file:line evidence for every claim.

14	  const input = [

17	    '    product: SfccProduct,',
18	    '  ) => boolean | undefined;',

2	Feature: PDP UI — Colour Swatches & Variation Selection
3	  As a shopper browsing the Zimmermann storefront
4	  I want to see and choose between the colours a product is available in
5	  So that I can decide which colourway to buy before adding it to my bag
6	
7	  Background:
8	    Given I am on the Zimmermann storefront
9	
10	  Scenario: A product with only one colour shows the colour name without swatches
11	    Given I navigate to a product detail page for a product available in only one colour
12	    When the page loads
13	    Then the colour label displays the name of that colour
14	    And no colour swatches are displayed
15	
16	  Scenario: A product with multiple colours shows one swatch per colour
17	    Given I navigate to a product detail page for a product available in several colours
18	    When the page loads
19	    Then a colour swatch is displayed for each available colour
20	    And each swatch shows the product image for that colour
21	
22	  Scenario: The colour currently being viewed is indicated as selected
23	    Given I navigate to a product detail page for a product available in several colours
24	    When the page loads
25	    Then one of the colour swatches is visually indicated as the selected colour
26	    And the colour label displays the name of that selected colour
27	
28	  Scenario: Choosing a different colour updates the address bar without reloading the page
29	    Given I am viewing a product detail page for a product available in several colours
30	    When I choose a colour that is not currently selected
31	    Then the address bar reflects the colour I chose
32	    And the page does not perform a full reload
33	    And the product information already on the page remains visible throughout
34	
35	  Scenario: Choosing a different colour updates the colour label and the selected swatch
36	    Given I am viewing a product detail page for a product available in several colours
37	    When I choose a colour that is not currently selected
38	    Then the colour label displays the name of the colour I chose
39	    And the swatch for the colour I chose is indicated as selected

## Scope Review — PR #70 (`feature/SFCC-91_pdp-ui-colour-swatches-variation-selection`, SHA `f9c6c74`)

**Method:** compared `git diff origin/develop..HEAD` against `git diff $(git merge-base origin/develop HEAD)..HEAD` (merge-base `04039a9`) to strip the SFCC-194 staleness noise — confirmed real: `git show 04039a9:overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx | grep -c variantScopedPriceData` returns `0`. The clean diff is 27 files, +1898/-32, and matches the manifest given in the task **exactly** (`git diff 04039a9..HEAD --numstat`) — no extra files, no missing files at the file-list level. `.claude/registry/*.md` churn is expected, not a finding. That file-level match is the *only* clean part of this PR — line-level, several things don't hold up.

---

### AC-by-AC (read from `colourSwatches/index.tsx` and `product-detail/index.tsx`, not the PR body)

- **AC1 (single colour → text label only):** IN SCOPE for the common case. `showSwatches = swatchVariants.length > 1` (`colourSwatches/index.tsx:95`) and `labelName` falls back to the sole variant's name when `swatchVariants.length === 1` (`:107`) — no swatch row renders, matches AC1. **Edge-case gap:** this only engages when the product's one colour also passes the image+orderable gate. If it doesn't, `hasOfferedColour` is `false` (`product-detail/index.tsx:307`), `ColourSwatches` never mounts, and the page falls back to `suppressColourAttribute={false}` → the base `SwatchGroup` renders that one colour via its own fallback (`name`-as-swatch or a coloured box), not the "Colour: <name>" text label AC1 specifies.

- **AC2/AC3 (one swatch per populated/orderable colour, selection indicated):** IN SCOPE. `role="radio"` / `aria-checked={isSelected}` per swatch (`colourSwatches/index.tsx:249-250`), `selectedIndicator` bar rendered when selected (`:269`), one swatch per entry in `swatchVariants` (`:236`).

- **AC4 (click updates `?color=`, no full reload):** IN SCOPE, verified. `handleColourSelect` (`product-detail/index.tsx:278-283`) does `history.replace(...)` (`:282`) — SPA navigation, not `location.href`/`window.location`. `useDerivedProduct` inside `ProductView` picks the new URL param up via its own param-watching hooks, exactly as documented in the surrounding comment (`:274-277`).

- **AC5 (no-image colour withheld entirely, never shown disabled):** **UNDER for the "zero offered colours" edge case — proven, not theoretical.** The gate is `hasOfferedColour = firstOfferedColour !== undefined` (`:307`), and when it's `false`, `suppressColourAttribute={hasOfferedColour}` (`:905`) also goes `false` — which un-suppresses the *base* `SwatchGroup` loop in `product-view/index.tsx` for the `color` attribute, rendering every (unavailable) colour value with `disabled={!orderable}`. This directly contradicts AC5 and — more importantly — **contradicts this PR's own e2e feature file**: `e2e/features/pdp/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.feature:71-75` ("A product whose colours are all unavailable shows no colour section at all... Then no colour label or swatches are displayed") and its matching (never-executed, see below) spec assertion at `e2e/tests/zimm/pdp/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.spec.js:206-208`. The code the PR shipped does not satisfy the scenario the PR itself wrote and claims to cover. This wiring lives entirely in `product-detail/index.tsx`, which has **no unit test file at all** (`find overrides/app/pages/product-detail -iname "*.test.*"` → only `staticProductHeader.test.tsx` and `productInfo.test.ts`), so nothing in Vitest or Storybook catches it either.

---

### `variant="square"` — dedicated verdict: **OVER**

Confirmed by reading `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` directly. The suppression check is `if (suppressColourAttribute && id === SFCC_COLOUR_ATTRIBUTE_ID) return null;` at line 801 — but the swatch-shape line at line 838, `variant="square"`, sits **outside** that guard, inside the `values.map(...)` that still runs for every attribute whenever `suppressColourAttribute` is `false` (its default). It replaced `variant={id === 'color' ? 'circle' : 'square'}` unconditionally.

Traced the callers that get the un-suppressed default (`grep` for `suppressColourAttribute` across `overrides/`, and for `components/product-view'` importers in `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/`):
- `product-view-modal/index.jsx` (cart quick-add) — no override exists, calls base `ProductView` with no knowledge of the prop.
- `product-view-modal/bundle.jsx` — same.
- `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx` — same, and this path is explicitly **Squad A territory** per `.claude/rules/squadA.md`.
- The PDP's own set/bundle child products, `product-detail/index.tsx:838-888` — no `suppressColourAttribute` passed there either, and set/bundle PDP is explicitly out of this ticket's stated boundary (standalone-PDP only).

All four now render colour swatches as squares instead of circles — a real, visible UI regression on surfaces this ticket never named. This is not disclosed anywhere: the introducing commit `4db254b`'s own message claims the opposite effect ("non-PDP callers... keep the default SwatchGroup for colour"), the PR body's file table only credits that commit with "`suppressColourAttribute` prop + `SFCC_COLOUR_ATTRIBUTE_ID` export," and the PR's test-plan checkbox ("Non-PDP consumers... colour SwatchGroup still renders") is technically true but silent on the shape change. Nothing in the diff or PR body scopes or justifies it — it reads as an unnoticed side effect of collapsing the ternary, not a deliberate decision. **Verdict: OVER** — an unauthorized behavioural change reaching outside the ticket's boundary into surfaces owned by another squad and into the PDP's own out-of-scope set/bundle path.

(Smaller, same-category note: the same commit also changed the standalone `Quantity:` label's translation to drop its baked-in colon and append it in JSX instead — `product-view/index.tsx:872-876` — to fix a genuine "Quantity::" double-colon bug in the *bundle* quantity display, which is also outside SFCC-91's standalone-PDP scope. Low-risk, 2 lines, but same pattern: an unrequested touch to bundle-flow output, undisclosed in the PR body's file table.)

---

### scripts / translations / e2e — dedicated verdict

- **`scripts/generateRegistry.mjs` + `generateRegistry.test.mjs`: IN SCOPE, legitimate.** Commit `fadd9bc`'s own message states the cause: touching `product-view/index.tsx` triggered the registry's auto-regen and exposed a pre-existing bug (`validateOrderability`'s multi-line type rendering wrong in `.claude/registry/components.md`). `cb3ff51` hardens the same fix against quoted-paren/comment edge cases. I ran it: `node --test scripts/generateRegistry.test.mjs` → **5/5 passing**. This is necessitated by the PR's own edit, not a drive-by.

- **`colour_swatches.*` translation keys: IN SCOPE**, match the `formatMessage` ids actually used in `colourSwatches/index.tsx` (`colour_swatches.label`, `.group.label`, `.pagination.*`).

- **`header.button.assistive_msg.search` in `translations/en-GB.json`, `en-US.json`, and compiled `en-XA.json`: OVER.** This key is unrelated to colour swatches — it belongs to `overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx:370`, a file this PR never touches (`git diff --stat` for `overrides/app/components/header/` is empty). It's confirmed absent from `default.json`/`en.json` even at HEAD, so it wasn't a pre-existing gap this PR closed everywhere — it's a partial, inconsistent side effect (added to only 2 of 4 locale files) of commit `f9c6c74`'s translation-sync step. `translations/` is Tier 2, Integration/SI-Partner-owned per `protectedFiles.md` ("notify before changing") — this specific addition is undisclosed in the PR body and unrelated to the ticket.

- **`e2e/tests/zimm/pdp/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.feature` (the Gherkin): IN SCOPE**, well-written, 11 scenarios that correctly capture all 5 ACs including the edge case above.

- **`e2e/tests/zimm/pdp/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.spec.js` + `ProductPage.js`: severe UNDER — proven by execution, not inference.** I ran this directly:
  - `require('./e2e/fixtures/products.js')` exports only `{standardProduct, multiVariantProduct, outOfStockProduct, saleProduct}`. The spec imports and calls `pdpProductWithMultipleColours`, `pdpProductWithUnpopulatedColour`, `pdpProductWithNonOrderableColour`, `pdpProductWithSingleColour`, `pdpProductWithAllColoursWithheld` — none exist. Calling one throws `TypeError: fixtures.pdpProductWithMultipleColours is not a function` (confirmed by direct call). `e2e/fixtures/products.js` is not in this PR's diff at all.
